author: MrJabbit
quote: To have it playable like this is actually criminal. Low frame rate that is not consistently stable. So many bugs that people have encountered. Some things you expect the realism to be there is not even there since they are so fixated on hyper-realism. The only saving grace is the graphics if you are just banking on that. The characters are boring especially Jason and having him do chores is not what most people ask for especially in GTA. If they were gonna have that, set it up for later when the story is picks up and deepens. They probably knew this was not well-optimized since they can resell this on PC and when the next generation of console hits. Sadly, this is a total messed and probably win GOTY.
